    From Netflix's own pricing pages, checked 4 Nov 2026. Prices in USD, ≈ converted at the day's rate (16 Nov); yearly prices are divided by 12.

    Netflix prices each country on its own, by what people there can pay and what competes locally, not by how big the catalogue is. Standard costs Rs 800 ($2.89) in Pakistan, $19.99 in the United States and $27.29 in Liechtenstein: a 9.4× gap for the same plan. 226 of the 245 countries we checked pay less than in the US. We read each country's prices from Netflix's Help Center and its own pricing pages.

    Questions

    Where is Netflix cheapest in 2026?+

    Pakistan, at Rs 800 a month ($2.89) for Standard.

    Why is Netflix cheaper in some countries?+

    Netflix sets each country's price by local incomes and competition, and accepts lower prices in growing markets to win subscribers. The size of the local catalogue isn't what drives it: two countries with similar libraries can pay very different prices.

    Is the picture quality worse in cheaper countries?+

    No. Quality depends on the plan, not the country: each plan has the same resolution and number of screens wherever it's sold. What differs is the catalogue, which follows regional licensing deals rather than the price.

    Why don't all countries have the same plans?+

    Netflix sells different plans per market. Some countries have a cheap Mobile plan, others have Standard with ads instead of Basic. Each plan is compared only with the same plan in other countries.

    Can I pay another country's Netflix price?+

    Netflix bills in the country where you sign up and checks your location and payment method, so another country's price isn't available just by changing your location.

    Does Netflix have regional pricing?+

    Yes. Standard has 69 different prices across the 245 verified countries, in 40 currencies: from ≈ $2.89 a month in Pakistan to ≈ $27.29 in Liechtenstein and 1 more, a 9.4× gap. Some of these prices are before tax and others include it, so part of the difference is tax.

    Which country is cheapest for each Netflix plan?+

    Standard: Pakistan (≈ $2.89 a month); Standard with ads: Brazil (≈ $4.57 a month); Basic: Pakistan (≈ $1.63 a month); Premium: Pakistan (≈ $3.97 a month); Mobile: Pakistan (≈ $0.90 a month). Only verified prices count, and yearly prices are divided by twelve.

    Why do subscription prices differ by country?+

    Companies set a price for each market based on what people there earn, what local rivals charge, taxes and the local currency. The same plan can cost several times more in one country than in another.

    Why might I see a different price than the one here?+

    Taxes, an introductory offer, paying in the iPhone app instead of on the website, or a recent price change. Prices in US dollars also move a little with the exchange rate, updated every week.

    Where do these prices come from?+

    From each service's own website or its App Store listing, read as a visitor from that country sees it. We check every month, convert with the same exchange rate for every country (updated every week), and only rank prices we could confirm.
